scenes.say: Modern C sharp has some cool features. Do you know which ones make your code cleaner and easier to read?

scenes.label: Pattern
scenes.sub: Check types and extract values in one step.
scenes.say: First up, pattern matching. It lets you check an object's type and pull out properties all at once.

scenes.code:
record Point(int X, int Y);
var p = new Point(3, 4);
scenes.say: Primary constructors make records and classes super simple to set up. No need for extra boilerplate.

scenes.label: Collections
scenes.sub: Quickly create lists with new syntax.
scenes.say: Collection expressions let you create lists with less code. Just brackets and your values.

scenes.question: How do you check a type and value?
scenes.right: Pattern matching checks type and extracts values in one line.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: don't use a bunch of if statements when pattern matching does it all in one go.
